The [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] wore '''tribal masks'''<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> to intimidate others. Later researchers believed that the Ysanna masks were inspired by the various [[Sith mask/Legends|dark side warrior masks]] left behind in the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]] of the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="GatORW" />
